findings.reproductionByControlFlow: During active loaded playback, native stalled can indicate unavailable network data while existing buffers keep audio moving. Handler sets timingWaiting=true unconditionally. Only playing clears it; uninterrupted buffered playback need not emit another playing event. Mark remains disabled although currentTime advances and readyState is usable.
findings.evidenceLimit: Source/event-contract reasoning only; no native network-stall reproduction performed.
findings.recommendation: Use actual waiting to suspend, or distinguish network stalled from playback starvation with a verified readiness/resumption condition.
findings.resolution: Only actual waiting sets timingWaiting; stalled no longer latches disabled playback. Actual readyState separately gates marking and playing clears the waiting flag.
